summary: 09:48 ET Week 3 refresh: no user-facing action changes. Christian Watson anytime TD remains PRIME's only actionable current Week 3 player-prop candidate. A new DraftKings Network article published today lists Watson +155, improving slightly from the prior archive's freshest direct DraftKings reference of +150, but the recommended stake, +135 hard floor and football thesis are unchanged. At +155, the stored 47.0% fair TD probability implies a 7.78-point edge (6-8% bucket); Dimers' independent 43.7% TD probability implies a smaller 4.48-point edge, so the position remains price-sensitive and 0.5u only if unplaced. Tucker Kraft anytime TD is now widely promoted and Covers displays a best current line of BetMGM +210, but Dimers gives Kraft only a 33.7% TD probability versus +210's 32.26% break-even, only about a 1.44-point edge, below PRIME's quality gate; classify PASS despite analyst support. Drake London O66.5 -112, Matthew Golden O52.5 -114, Jordan Love passing 228.5 and other TNF markets were rechecked; none produced a sufficiently robust current-price edge after projection disagreement, injury context and same-thesis exposure. Final team injury status remains unchanged, no official game-day inactives are available yet, and no Week 3 user ticket is recorded.
